default.$description: Default divider and outline — cards, input borders, table dividers

strong.$description: Stronger border — active input ring, emphasized dividers

subtle.$description: Very light separator — inner table rules, inline sections

focus.$description: Focus ring color — applied to all interactive elements

action.$description: Border on secondary/ghost buttons in their action color

danger.$description: Input or control in error state

success.$description: Input or control in valid/success state
